vulns.source: reproduced by hand: the invoice endpoint resolves an authenticated session and never asks whether its role may read the object, so both seeded identities (admin, user) read it. Proven by the flipped two-session re-measure at grade differential.

reproduced by hand: the same broken authorization as invoices/4821 (the fixture serves any id to any authenticated session), but declared with capability public_param only (no access_differs_by_session), so the deterministic plan table and idor_differential both skip it — only a model-proposed object-read can cover it.

hand-verified negative for the loop: the owner reads the report (200) and the authenticated low-privilege session gets a 500 (the boundary check throws instead of denying). This is a *surprise*, not a finding — the object-read plan retains it as an anomaly and the run must settle none here without inventing a vuln.
